snippet.title: Slot Machine Gun - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
A roguelike deckbuilder shooter where you wield an ever changing weapon : The Slot Machine Gun!
Every reload spins up a fresh combo of guns and chaotic effects to create game breaking synergies.

Whishlist the game on Steam : ! https://store.steampowered.com/app/3891420/Slot_Machine_Gun
Join our Discord for news and production sneak peeks: https://discord.com/invite/ARF4Jtgbfd

///

Illustration : Gwendoline Legendre | https://www.instagram.com/taikgwendo/
Video editing : Rémi Bocherens | https://www.instagram.com/remibocherens/
Composer : Gaël Barbance | https://www.instagram.com/gael.barbance/
